FN-6P9811-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 238
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Senator Gerald Allen
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/24/2023
Senate Bill 238 as introduced proposes a constitutional amendment which, if ratified, could
increase the administrative costs of local boards of education by an undetermined amount to
establish policies requiring public K-12 schools to broadcast "The Star-Spangled Banner" at
least once a week during school hours.
In addition, this bill will increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the
State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2024.
